_comment: Defaults for the Jetson Orin Nano Super (8GB unified). setup.sh rewrites the paths; edit config.local.json to override anything without touching this file. The shipped default is the fast pair verified on hardware: Gemma at UD-Q2_K_XL plus Pocket TTS on the GPU (~1.5s to first sound). The pair matters: GPU speech needs a second CUDA context (~0.6GB plus compute buffers) that does NOT fit next to Gemma Q4 - if you raise quant to UD-Q4_K_XL for smarter answers, set ttsOnGpu to false (speech then takes ~19s/sentence on the ARM cores). contextSize 2048 is the verified-safe default on 8GB - see the memory budget in the README before raising it.
